definitions.explanation: Woven or knitted material used to make clothing or other items.
A mixture of flour and liquid used for baking.
A person's true personality without pretense.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{生地|きじ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{柔|やわ}らかい→柔らかい：01096_yawarakai⟧。
⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{生地|きじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦こねる→捏ねる：06187_koneru⟧。
⟦ドレス→ドレス：00037_doresu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{生地|きじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: To choose fabric for a dress.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{生地|きじ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{厚|あつ}くて→厚い：00690_atsui⟧⟦{丈夫|じょうぶ}なので→丈夫：01156_joubu⟧、⟦コート→コート：01358_kooto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}いている→向く：02304_muku⟧。
examples.english: This fabric is thick and sturdy, so it's suitable for a coat.

examples.english: Normally polite, but when tired, their true nature shows and their tone gets rough.

notes:
{生地|きじ} has multiple meanings depending on context.

FABRIC MEANING:
- {生地|きじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧ (to choose fabric)
- ⟦{綿|めん}→綿：03807_men⟧{生地|きじ} (cotton fabric)
- ⟦{絹|きぬ}→絹：01383_kinu⟧{生地|きじ} (silk fabric)

DOUGH MEANING:
- {生地|きじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦こねる→捏ねる：06187_koneru⟧ (to knead dough)
- ⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{生地|きじ} (bread dough)
- ⟦ピザ→ピザ：06769_piza⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{生地|きじ} (pizza dough)

TRUE NATURE MEANING:
- {生地|きじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (true nature comes out)
- {生地|きじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧ (to show one's true colors)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {生地|きじ}: fabric, dough
- ⟦{布|ぬの}→布：01489_nuno⟧: cloth (general term)
- ⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧: material (broader term)
